scope: Independent read-only review of final source, public source compatibility, actual pinned Apache schema delta and submitted tests; no compilation, test execution or peer rerun by this reviewer.

findings.result: Existing FetchPartition fields/layout and constructors unchanged; decode tuple alias retains the same structural tuple and field order. New replica watermarks use explicitly selected aligned sidecar functions.

Encoder emits sorted partition tags0(directory) and1(watermark); omits defaultMAX and omits watermark on lower versions. Both decoders validate exactly8 bytes for known18 tag1; older versions skip unknown tags. No replica/quorum acknowledgement semantics claimed.
Sidecar dimensions are checked after version validation and before any buffer writes, including empty topics/partitions. Existing decoder does not allocate a watermark sidecar.

Both control and per-leader data connection negotiation use the shared max18 constant; ordinary consumer encoder omits unsupported-default watermark. Lower names/UUIDs and session behavior retain existing version branches.

Apache fixtures cover empty/default/unknown/zero/known/signedMIN/both tags/unknown tags/session; lower17 omission fixtures and exact request/response pairs. Negative tests cover exact known tag length, duplicate/unordered tags, every truncation and pre-write shape failure. Five maintained consumer cases run12 and18 with observed socket version assertions, alongside existing lower-version/session/fallback coverage.
